##### Project general facts

Beach Walk Grand by Imtiaz is a sculptural residential landmark whose flowing, wave-like balconies make it instantly memorable and utterly distinctive. The collection brings together elegant one and two bedroom apartments along with a very limited number of exceptional three bedroom penthouses, giving buyers a wonderful range of choices. The penthouses in particular are a private retreat for those who value peace, space and exclusivity, with open layouts, high ceilings, private terraces and generous balconies that create a bright, airy ambiance and uninterrupted views.

The rooftop is the true showpiece, home to a serene infinity pool finished in sleek mosaic tiles with soft ambient lighting, paired with a stylish rooftop lounge made for sunset gatherings and quiet moments alike. A stunning luxury pool with infinity edges sits alongside the peaceful perch, a beautifully lit seating area designed for relaxation and elegant get-togethers under the open sky. Residents also enjoy a superb clubhouse with cosy lounges, a billiards table and space for private events, plus a state-of-the-art indoor gym with personal training options and a truly grand entrance lobby crowned by a sculptural chandelier.

Every residence comes fully furnished with custom-designed furniture, so each home feels complete, considered and ready to enjoy from day one. The heart of the home is a fully fitted kitchen featuring top European brands including Miele, Gessi and Villeroy & Boch, combining beautiful marble surfaces, handleless cabinetry, fine gold detailing and backlit display shelving. Warm herringbone wood flooring, elegant marble accents, sleek fitted closets with built-in lighting and serene bathrooms with refined fixtures complete the picture, while integrated smart home systems put effortless control at your fingertips.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters.

The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities.

Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.
